text: 无论如何我也没有想到，在未来确定的那一天里，我将迎来我的40岁。
en: However it came about, I never imagined that on that fixed day in the future I would be meeting my 40th year.

text: 说没有想到，并不是对自己寿命的怀疑，而是无论如何也没有做好准备，迎接这一个具有标志意义的年纪。
en: To say I had not foreseen it is not to doubt my own lifespan, but rather that, no matter what, I was not at all prepared to greet this landmark age.

text: 时至今日，我还以为自己只有25岁，从别人的反馈中也不难有此结论（他们都说我幼稚，可他们只不过是被现实干翻了而已，我只是还站在血泊里。
en: To this day I still think of myself as only twenty-five; from others' feedback one can readily draw this conclusion (they all say I am childish, yet they were merely brought low by reality, whereas I am simply still standing in the bloodbath.

text: 倒下的人见不得别人没倒下，他们就恶心人。
en: Those who have fallen cannot bear to see others still on their feet; they simply disgust people.

text: ）然而我就要在今年达成我的40岁成就，这可怕的年纪啊。
en: )Yet this year I am about to reach my 40-year milestone — this dreadful age.

text: 上学的时候曾默默在心中定下人生目标——在30岁赚够100万，然后就娶个老婆。
en: In my school days I once silently set a life goal in my heart — to earn a million by the age of thirty, then take a wife.

text: 如今这个目标，只有年纪在10年前就实现了，真想骂脏话。
en: As things stand, of that goal only the age was reached ten years early; I really feel like swearing.

text: 也许是年轻时自己把女人缘给败光，亦或是某一任女友对我下了蛊，让我至今还没找到归宿。
en: Perhaps I squandered my luck with women in my youth, or perhaps some former girlfriend put a curse on me, so that to this day I have yet to find where I belong.

text: 一想到这把年纪还是单身，就让我感到不寒而栗。
en: The mere thought that at this age I am still single sends a chill down my spine.

text: 不禁让我想到左小祖咒的那首歌里唱得：「阿姐有窝无鸟宿，阿哥有鸟却无窝。
en: I cannot help but recall that song by Xiaozuzhou Zuo, which sings: 「The elder sister has a nest but no bird to lodge in, the elder brother has a bird yet no nest.

text: 某天我在楼下遛狗，与一位妙龄女郎擦肩而过，她的样貌身材都令人眼前一亮，引得我和旁边一位大爷献上注目礼。
en: One day I was walking the dog downstairs and brushed past a young lady; her looks and figure were striking, drawing both me and an old gentleman beside me to offer an admiring gaze.

text: 直到小狗疯狂拽我让我继续走，我这才不情愿地结束了注目礼。
en: It was only when the little dog tugged me frantically to move on that I reluctantly ended my admiring gaze.

text: 而那位大爷始终矗立在那里，像一尊绽放着男性光辉地塑像，目光伴随女子远去，直至被建筑物遮挡。
en: That old gentleman stood there the whole time, like a statue radiating masculine splendour, his eyes following the woman as she walked away until she was hidden by the building.

text: 我猜大爷有拆了那建筑物的心。
en: I suspect the old man felt like tearing that building down.

text: 他的行为让我联想到自己——是不是这辈子就这样了？
en: His behaviour made me think of myself — is this all my life is going to be?

text: 再也没有机会体验到嘴唇轻触双舌交缠的滋味，简而言之就是没有办法「一图口舌之快」了。
en: Never again will I have the chance to taste lips lightly touching and two tongues entwined; in short, there is no way to 'indulge a quick pleasure of the lips and tongue'.

text: 再也不能摸着洁白如雪的胸口，感受那融化心灵的柔软，简而言之就是没法做一个「吃软不吃硬」的人了。
en: Never again can I stroke a breast white as snow and feel that softness that melts the soul; in short, I can no longer be one who 'takes the soft but not the hard'.

text: 再也没有可能因为一个人的身体而为之疯狂，即便年纪尚有余力终日无处施展。
en: Never again am I likely to be driven mad by a person's body, even though at my age I still have vigour to spare with nowhere to spend it all day.

text: 哪怕曾经的回忆再丰富，也不够我下半生反复凭吊，这真令人感到操大蛋啊。
en: Even if my past memories are rich, they are not enough for me to revisit through my remaining years; this truly makes one feel what a bloody mess.

text: 我可不想用「反正该玩的都玩过了」来安慰自己，这是80岁之后的话术，轮不到老子现在就用来给自己洗脑啊！
en: I have no wish to console myself with 'well, I've done it all anyway' — that is the talk of someone past eighty, and it is hardly my turn, at this age, to use it to brainwash myself!

text: 40岁，真的不惑了？
en: Forty years old — truly free of doubt?

text: 四十到底是「不惑」还是「不活」？
en: Is forty 'free of doubt' or 'free of living'?

text: 干翻这个世界的劲头尚且还有残存，可是世界好像都已经不存在了。
en: The drive to bring down this world still lingers in me, yet the world seems no longer to exist.

text: 曾经把心爱的人当做全世界，想着干翻她就等于干翻了世界，从而曲线实现伟大理想，然而即使这样的愿望也十分渺茫。
en: I once took my beloved as the whole world, thinking that bringing her down equalled bringing down the world, and thus achieving my great ideal by a roundabout route; yet even such a wish is faint indeed.

text: 只能狠狠地干翻自己，问自己想要什么，最好是不需要其他人参与的东西，因为不想为难任何人，只有为难我自己。
en: I can only bring myself down hard, asking what I want — preferably something that needs no one else's participation, because I do not wish to make things difficult for anyone, only for myself.

text: 自己沦为自己的玩物，自己也就是自己的世界，干翻自己，这样说起来还真滑稽。
en: Oneself becomes one's own plaything; oneself is one's own world; to bring oneself down — said like that, it is truly absurd.

text: 单身得越久，内心聚集的爱意就更浓、更烈，谁要是不经意撩拨一下，后果犹如火山爆发、地震、海啸…
en: The longer one stays single, the thicker and fiercer the love gathered in the heart; should anyone inadvertently stir it, the consequence is like a volcanic eruption, an earthquake, a tsunami…

text: 别人的爱如潮水，我的爱如海啸，根本没人受得了，还是自己玩蛋显得方便许多。
en: Others' love is like the tide; my love is like a tsunami — no one can bear it at all. Still, amusing oneself alone seems far more convenient.

text: 我这稀里糊涂的人生啊，就这么过去了一半。
en: My muddled life, thus half gone.

text: 即使挠破头，也已经记不清来时的路了，像是有个无形的力量，不厌其烦地将我走过的痕迹抹去。
en: Even if I scratch my head raw, I can no longer recall the road I came by, as if some invisible force tirelessly erases the traces of where I have been.

text: 而摆在面前的一切，又都是那么捉摸不定、混沌不堪，甚至觉得连这混沌的一切也都并不存在。
en: Yet everything before me is so uncertain and chaotic, even to the point of feeling that even this chaos does not exist.

text: 四十不惑，就别霍霍了。
en: Forty and free of doubt — so stop wreaking havoc.

text: 我今年46岁，心态成熟很多，不再有不切实际的幻想，能够控制自己的情绪，注意身体健康，更加珍惜时间，比年轻的时候更能理解别人，不再强求别人和自己。
en: I am forty-six this year, far more mature in mindset, no longer harbouring unrealistic fantasies, able to control my emotions, mindful of my health, treasuring time more, understanding others better than in my youth, and no longer forcing others or myself.

text: 40岁的未来，积极的去学习，去成长。
en: In the years of my forties to come, I learn and grow with initiative.

text: 有点抑郁。
en: Rather depressed.

text: 因人而异，个人觉得和20几岁时没有差别。
en: It varies from person to person; personally I feel no different from my twenties.

text: 心态还是年轻，身体也还好。
en: My mindset is still young, and my body is fine too.

text: 人生最难的就是45-55岁之间，深水区，上有老，下有小，工作一大堆，奔涌吧，中年。
en: The hardest stretch of life is between forty-five and fifty-five — the deep-water zone, with the elderly above and the children below, and piles of work. Surge on, middle age.

text: 受到网上大厂年终供方议价函的启发，做非标设备的公司也起了心思，当天起草了份致供方的降价函，岂料非标设备本就产品种类多且单种数量少，掀起来一阵腥风血雨.
en: Inspired by the year-end supplier price-negotiation letters from big firms circulating online, a company that makes non-standard equipment also took the notion, and that very day drafted a price-reduction letter to suppliers — little did they expect that non-standard equipment, by nature offering many product types but few of each, would stir up a bloody storm.

text: 许薇所在的采购部大早上收到销售总发来的供方议价函，虽然这事网上已上热搜，私底下也有些讨论，但被公司内部正式谈起且要正式出函供方还是有些诧异。
en: The purchasing department where Wei Xu works received early in the morning a supplier price-negotiation letter from the sales director; although the matter had already trended online and been quietly discussed, it was still somewhat surprising that the company was formally raising it internally and meant to issue a formal letter to suppliers.

text: 网络流传的大厂毕竟生产标准品，采购产品种类不多且数量可观，最关键的是大公司付款准时，供方即使利润微薄但也为博个与大厂合作的名头或者薄利多销勉强让步接受。
en: The big firms whose letters spread online, after all, produce standard goods, procuring few product types in considerable quantities; most crucially, the large companies pay on time, so even if suppliers' profits are thin, they grudgingly concede to gain the prestige of cooperating with a big firm, or to profit from small margins and high volumes.

text: 自己公司做非标设备，产品种类五花八门，每种数量零零落落，付款是能拖即拖。
en: Our own company makes non-standard equipment, with a bewildering variety of products, each in scattered small quantities, and payment is delayed whenever possible.

text: 但是采购是执行层，似乎不积极的发函催促供方即与供方有勾结暗中获利之嫌。
en: But purchasing is the execution layer; not actively issuing letters to press suppliers risks suspicion of colluding with suppliers for secret gain.

text: 所以即使知道可能面临的反弹，采购部的几人还是一家家的发函过去。
en: So even knowing the possible backlash, the few in the purchasing department still sent letters to suppliers one by one.

text: 如料想一致，大部分供方是无回应，毕竟做生意和气生财，还有些尾款被压着没必要大动干戈。
en: As expected, most suppliers gave no response — after all, in business harmony brings wealth, and with some final payments being withheld there was no need to make a great fuss.

text: 待到第三天汇报进展一看根本是毫无进展，会议室顶端位置上的徐总顶着稀疏的不多毛发皱起眉头，声如洪钟：这样可不行，大家集思广益，一起来商量对策。
en: By the third day, the progress report showed essentially no progress. Director Xu, seated in the top seat of the meeting room with his sparse, thinning hair, frowned and said in a voice like a great bell: 'This will not do. Let us pool our ideas and discuss a strategy together.'

text: 采购部几人先是不作声，最后实在耗不过去，毕业就来公司性格相对直接的李东客观的从采购的产品品质，数量，价格，货期几要素来总结：以未来订单作诱饵可惜合作年数已久供方也清楚数量，以经济形势差实业艰难打同情牌，供方倒是更情真意切的哭起来了穷，甚至打出要借钱发员工工资的凄惨文字来，最后只能先以本月付款需在得到年度降价的具体方案后才能执行来变相威胁。
en: The few in purchasing first said nothing; finally, unable to stall any longer, Dong Li — who joined straight from graduation and has a relatively direct character — objectively summarised from the factors of purchased product quality, quantity, price and delivery: using future orders as bait was a pity, since the cooperation had lasted years and suppliers knew the quantities; playing the sympathy card by citing the poor economy and hard times for industry only made suppliers weep more sincerely about their poverty, even producing miserable words about needing to borrow money to pay staff wages; in the end they could only resort to a disguised threat — that this month's payment would be executed only after a concrete annual price-reduction plan was obtained.

text: 采购部几人看着这个最终说辞面露难色，也只能应着先去谈谈。
en: The few in purchasing, seeing this final wording, looked embarrassed but could only agree to go and talk first.

text: 许薇看着工作微信里不断的红点闪烁一阵头皮发麻，收款是销售最大的考核，特别是年底，对于销售而言辛苦一年，需以最终回款核算奖金。
en: Wei Xu watched the endless flashing red dots in her work WeChat and felt a numbness creep over her scalp; collections are the sales force's biggest assessment metric, especially at year-end, when for salespeople a hard year's work must be settled into bonuses by final repayment.

text: 以站不住脚端不上台面的理由来延后付款，这是要了合作方销售的命额。
en: To delay payment on flimsy, undignified grounds — that is simply to take the life of the partner's sales staff.

text: 合作方率先反弹的是大厂和外资。
en: The first partners to push back were the big firms and the foreign-funded ones.

text: 平时比较平和谦逊的供方朱丽直接甩出合同，提醒需按时付款，财务会根据付款安排后续发货事宜，直接一招断货威胁。
en: Li Zhu, a supplier who is usually gentle and modest, directly threw down the contract, reminding them that payment must be on time and that finance would arrange subsequent shipments based on payment — a straightforward threat to cut off supply.

text: 这临时找供方验证产品都需要时间，只能先以客户要求降价自己也是迫不得已的跟进来缓和。
en: Finding a supplier to verify products at such short notice takes time; all we could do was first soften things by saying the customer had demanded a price cut and that we too were reluctantly following along.

text: 赶紧先汇报，本来只是要求降价，这弄不好被断了货导致产线停在那简直是采购的大罪过。
en: Hurry to report first — originally we only asked for a price cut; if mishandled and supply is cut, halting the production line, that would be a grave sin for purchasing.

text: 还是让徐总去定夺。
en: Best to let Director Xu decide.

text: 徐总先瞟了眼许薇，开口道:再谈谈，这也不是形势所迫嘛，你看公司这情况，哪哪都是出去的费用，再说这降价的业绩也关系到你们的考核。
en: Director Xu first glanced at Wei Xu and said: 'Talk some more — it is not as if we are forced by circumstances. Look at the company's situation: expenses going out everywhere. Besides, this price-cut result also bears on your assessments.'

text: ”这考核一出口简直是定海神针，许薇太多准备解释的话堵在那，只能咽回口中，回到：我再去跟供方谈谈”怎么谈呢，别的大厂好歹有个量甚至有个未来的量像个吊在马前面的胡萝卜，我们这公司只能卖惨啊。
en: ”The moment the word 'assessment' left his mouth it was like a stabilising anchor; the many explanations Wei Xu had prepared lodged in her throat, and she could only swallow them back, replying: I'll go and talk to the supplier again” But how to talk, indeed? Other big firms at least have volume, even future volume, like a carrot dangling before a horse; our company can only peddle its misery.

text: 四处询价询了个低点的截图给朱丽，言辞恳切的讲多少支持点，毕竟也是合作多年的生意伙伴，朱丽这次倒也没有一口回绝，只说我再来申请下，许薇一看有希望，忙说等您好消息。
en: Having canvassed around for prices, she sent Li Zhu a screenshot of a lower quote, earnestly asking for some support, seeing as they were business partners of many years; this time Li Zhu did not refuse outright, only saying she would apply again. Wei Xu, seeing hope, hurriedly said she looked forward to good news.

text: 接近下班，朱丽的企业微信回了，只能折中让两个点，再三强调这个价格是特价，其他家都没这样操作过。
en: Near clocking-off, Li Zhu replied on WeCom, willing only to compromise with a two-point concession, repeatedly stressing that this was a special price no other supplier had been given.

text: 许薇一切了然，但也只能缓缓打出”多谢支持”的字样。
en: Wei Xu understood it all, yet could only slowly type out the words 'Thank you for your support'.

text: 总算肯下一个硬骨头，许薇暂时松下口气。
en: Having finally cracked a hard nut, Wei Xu breathed a temporary sigh of relief.

text: 突然旁边位置的李东发出了声巨大的“握草”。
en: Suddenly Dong Li, in the next seat, let out a great 'Bloody hell'.

text: 李东也算是公司的老人，毕业就在这家公司，到现在成为两个小孩的爸爸。
en: Dong Li counts as a veteran of the company, having joined straight after graduation and now a father of two children.

text: 因为做非标设备，采购的料种类多且数量零散，公司为节约成本，也没有专业的品种归类采购，更没有从第三方平台采购，更多的是从厂家直采，这导致李东负责的供方多而杂。
en: Because the work is non-standard equipment, the purchased materials are varied and scattered in quantity; to save costs the company has no specialised category-based purchasing, nor third-party platform sourcing — mostly direct procurement from manufacturers. This leaves Dong Li with many and varied suppliers.

text: 加上他性格比较直接，家中琐事也多，原来是跟供方周旋几次未得结果，徐总那又不断施压，导致跟供方讲了硬话，供方倒是一点没有退让，直接寄出了律师函。
en: Combined with his fairly direct character and many household trivialities, after several rounds of negotiation with suppliers yielded nothing and Director Xu kept applying pressure, he ended up speaking bluntly to the suppliers, who did not back down at all and directly sent a lawyer's letter.

text: 原本只是年终降价，最后演变成打官司，李东眼看事态越发严峻，立马上报徐总，徐总捧着他那茶杯老神在在的听完，也知道李东掩饰了些对自己不利的部分，没有点破，只是和稀泥的强调“打官司得不偿失嘛”，其实也是心知，做生意虽然出声问价，坐地还价，但也确实没有强买强卖的道理。
en: What began as merely a year-end price cut escalated into litigation. Dong Li, seeing the situation grow ever graver, immediately reported to Director Xu, who listened, teacup in hand, utterly unfazed, well aware that Dong Li had concealed parts unfavourable to himself but did not expose him, only smoothing things over with the remark 'litigation is just not worth it'. In truth he also knew that, while in business one may ask prices and haggle on the spot, there is genuinely no justification for forced buying or selling.

text: 李东当然明白徐总的意思，自己捅下的篓子，还要调整心态，自己去安抚供方，让对方撤诉。
en: Dong Li of course understood Director Xu's meaning: the mess he had made, he must adjust his attitude and go soothe the supplier himself, getting them to withdraw the suit.

text: 因为这些琐事造成加班晚归，那边老婆又打电话催回家小孩在哭闹，李东哄完老婆对许薇苦笑了下，中年牛马，都是一样。
en: Because these trivialities kept him working late and returning home late, and his wife was on the phone urging him home while the child cried, Dong Li, having coaxed his wife, gave Wei Xu a wry smile: middle-aged beasts of burden, all the same.

text: 许薇也没好到哪里去，老公刘涛所在的公司在降本增效，部门已经裁员一轮，因为确实有输出，人也相对机灵，暂时安全。
en: Wei Xu was not much better off; her husband Tao Liu's company is cutting costs and boosting efficiency, and his department has already had one round of layoffs. Because he does produce results and is relatively sharp, he is safe for now.

text: 只是销售那一直接不到项目，或者低价接的项目一算后期服务费，居然还亏了。
en: Only, the sales side keeps landing no projects, or the low-price projects they take, once you calculate the later service fees, actually lose money.

text: 也不知道哪天裁到他头上，所以家里也一直笼罩着焦虑。
en: No one knows when the axe will fall on him, so the household is perpetually shrouded in anxiety.

text: 许薇有时在想人活着这么累的意义是什么？
en: Wei Xu sometimes wonders what the meaning is of living so wearily.

text: 所有的需求不过是衣食住行，难道是所有人都希望比别人好一点，不落人后？
en: All our needs are merely food, clothing, shelter and travel — could it be that everyone simply wishes to be a little better than others, not falling behind?

text: 他们还是没生小孩的状态。
en: They are still in the state of having no child.

text: 看看同事李东的情况，简直是地狱模式，想想都生无可恋。
en: Looking at colleague Dong Li's situation — it is practically hell mode; the thought alone makes one want to give up on life.

text: 所以对于婆婆的催生，许薇是非常抗拒，自己的生活都过不好，还是不要连累小孩了。
en: So towards her mother-in-law's pressure to have children, Wei Xu is deeply resistant: she cannot even live her own life well, so better not to drag a child into it.

text: 只能让刘涛去挡住老太一轮轮的催生。
en: She can only have Tao Liu fend off the old lady's round after round of baby-pressure.

text: 不过看今年的架势，老太准备过年杀到他们小家，不得到确定的回复不回去了。
en: But judging by this year's posture, the old lady is prepared to descend upon their little household for the New Year and not return until she gets a definite answer.

text: 又是一场恶仗，许薇更是觉得了无生趣。
en: Another bitter battle — Wei Xu feels even more that life has lost its flavour.

text: 这个年终在声势浩大的降价中结束了，实际的收益其实心知肚明，只是职场需要的是服从执行，每个成熟的职场人常用语从来都是“好的，收到”而非“我觉得”等你靠着忍耐左右逢源爬到更高的位置，自然有可以领导的人，真是令人绝望的世界。
en: This year-end ended amid the grand campaign of price cuts; the actual gain is clear to all, yet the workplace demands obedience and execution. Every seasoned professional's stock phrase is always 'Noted, received' rather than 'I think' — and only once you have climbed higher through forbearance and smooth manoeuvring will there be people you can lead. What a hopeless world.
